name: Unstable Stasis · Death · Fire
primary:
A beam to the aim point hits everyone along it. In instant mode it keeps firing while held. Effects:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ arcane + 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
